Archive Sweep must run at autopilot startup before Phase 0/prerequisites, treating SPEC-001, SPEC-002, SPEC-002A, and SPEC-003 as previously merged candidates and excluding SPEC-004.

Round 1 adversarial peer-review remediation updated the workflow/state ledger to include mandatory consensus checkpoints, exact live implementation paths, safe-evaluation gates, and dependency audit gates.

Round 2 adversarial peer-review remediation tightened SPEC-004 terminal-success coverage, runtime dependency pins, AJV safety profile, routing pre-validation caps, combined latency acceptance, workflow-template PUT/delete coverage, and mandatory real Playwright UI acceptance.

Round 2 dependency validation added exact direct runtime pins for ajv@8.18.0, jsonpath-plus@10.4.0, and safe-regex@2.1.1. `pnpm audit --audit-level high` currently reports high advisories that must be resolved before P3-AC8 can pass.

Round 3 final adversarial peer-review remediation added the existing-branch guard for Specify, clarified routing-failure stall semantics, hardened schema pattern safety beyond safe-regex alone, made workflow-template delete repair explicit, and required quality-gate CI coverage for SPEC-004 audit and static guardrails.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: SPEC-004 owns remediating the current `pnpm audit --audit-level high` advisories rather than treating them as an external blocker; autopilot must update package/lock/CI as needed until the audit passes.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: workflow-template delete repair must support the existing live editor query-parameter path `DELETE /api/workflows?id=...`; JSON `{ id }` body support may remain only as backward-compatible optional behavior.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: every live non-`done` to `done` path for pipeline-bound tasks must route through one shared `advanceTaskChain` helper from `runAegisReviews`, `POST /api/quality-review`, bulk `PUT /api/tasks`, and detail `PUT /api/tasks/[id]`; manual/API completions remain allowed only through that helper.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: for a pipeline-bound task with `output_schema`, missing `tasks.resolution` or invalid structured output is a validation failure; mark the parent `failed`, record activity, and create no successor.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: if successor assignee resolution finds no matching `project_agent_assignments.agent_name` for `workflow_template.agent_role`, chain advancement stalls with activity evidence, parent terminal-success preservation, and no successor.
Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: workflow-template create/update must reject non-empty `routing_rules` unless `output_schema` is present; static `next_template_slug` without schema remains valid.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: when creating the first successor from a parent with no lineage, initialize the parent as root (`root_task_id = parent.id`, generated `chain_id`, `chain_stage = 0`) before inserting the successor with the same root/chain and `chain_stage = 1`.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: `advanceTaskChain` and successor creation must run in one database transaction covering parent lineage initialization, validation failure state/activity writes, stall activity writes, duplicate-successor guard checks, and successor insertion.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: duplicate-successor protection is DB-backed; SPEC-004 adds a partial unique index on `tasks(parent_task_id)` where `parent_task_id IS NOT NULL` after a zero-duplicate preflight, with rollback dropping the index; runtime still treats existing successor retries as idempotent no-ops.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: every SPEC-004 chain failure or advancement-stall activity must include human-readable text plus stable machine-readable `activities.data.reason_code` metadata for missing output, invalid output, routing rejection, routing timeout, target resolution stalls, and missing successor assignee.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: recovery from missing/invalid output uses an explicit operator-only `POST /api/tasks/[id]` action `{ "action": "retry_chain_advancement" }`; ordinary failed-to-`done` updates must not rerun chain advancement, and recovery provenance must not duplicate full corrected output in `activities.data`.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: `retry_chain_advancement` uses current workflow-template rules, but compares failure-time and current template schema/routing/next hashes and returns 409 until the operator sends `confirm_template_drift=true` before retrying across drift.

Owner clarification on 2026-04-30: `retry_chain_advancement` is the single operator recovery action for both failed output-validation parents and terminal-success advancement stalls; failed parents are eligible only for missing/invalid output, stalled terminal-success parents are retried without changing failure state, recovery provenance records `recovery_class`, and ineligible state/reason pairs return 409 without side effects.

Cleanup remains unsafe by default. Prior-spec cleanup may be applied only after archive success, merge/tree references, recovery commands, a clean safe base branch, and safeToApplyCleanup=true are recorded.
